decision: The complete expansion patch changes only TypeScript definite-assignment annotations on upstream fields and upstream test fixtures; it adds no initializer, runtime statement, template, style, public behavior or build configuration. The owned package provides a historical expansion Sass companion and shared bridge, not an owned copy of the changed current component sources; those actual current source members and their exported Sass boundary are separately bound. This source-only conclusion does not assert execution, current-peer behavioral inheritance, native or forced-colors qualification, the 21.x line, security clearance, or G11. The current owned library compiler configuration explicitly disables strictPropertyInitialization; this does not assert that another compiler configuration will accept unmodified sources.
